definitions.gloss: sweat gland — the gland in the skin that produces perspiration
definitions.explanation: One of the glands in the skin that secretes sweat. Humans have two main types: {エクリン汗腺|かんせん} (eccrine sweat glands), distributed over most of the body and important for temperature regulation, and {アポクリン汗腺|かんせん} (apocrine sweat glands), found mainly in the armpits and groin and linked to body odor.

examples.japanese: {汗腺|かんせん}から{汗|あせ}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: Sweat comes out from the sweat glands.

examples.japanese: {人間|にんげん}の{体|からだ}には{何百万|なんびゃくまん}もの{汗腺|かんせん}がある。
examples.english: The human body has millions of sweat glands.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}によって{汗腺|かんせん}の{働|はたら}きが{活発|かっぱつ}になり、{体温調節|たいおんちょうせつ}がうまくできるようになる。
examples.english: Exercise activates the sweat glands, improving the body's ability to regulate its temperature.

notes:
Compound of {汗|かん} ('sweat') and {腺|せん} ('gland'). Has several homophones including {幹線|かんせん} ('trunk line'), {感染|かんせん} ('infection'), and {観戦|かんせん} ('watching a match').

USAGE:
- Medical and biological term; used in health articles, textbooks, and discussions of skin care, thermoregulation, and body odor.
- Commonly specified with type prefixes: エクリン{汗腺|かんせん} (eccrine) and アポクリン{汗腺|かんせん} (apocrine).
- Related everyday concepts include {発汗|はっかん} ('sweating/perspiration') and {体温調節|たいおんちょうせつ} ('body-temperature regulation').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汗腺|かんせん}が{発達|はったつ}する: the sweat glands develop / become active
- {汗腺|かんせん}を{刺激|しげき}する: to stimulate the sweat glands
- {汗腺|かんせん}の{働|はたら}き: the function of sweat glands
- エクリン{汗腺|かんせん}: eccrine sweat gland
- アポクリン{汗腺|かんせん}: apocrine sweat gland

RELATED WORDS:
- {腺|せん}: gland — general suffix.
- {汗|あせ}: sweat
- {発汗|はっかん}: perspiration; the act of sweating
- {皮脂腺|ひしせん}: sebaceous gland — oil-producing gland in the skin.
- {甲状腺|こうじょうせん}: thyroid gland — another gland using the same {腺|せん} suffix.
